name: ClearPolicy API
description:
Access your organization's people, groups, documents, and document requests. API tokens are organization-scoped and require an active trial or subscription. Owners and administrators can use all listed endpoints; Group Manager tokens can use GET /me but receive 403 on the other endpoints.

Each API token is limited to 60 requests per minute. Respect Retry-After on 429 responses and use the X-RateLimit-* headers to track the allowance.
